A village in Rohatyn urban hromada, Ivano-Frankivsk Raion, Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast, Ukraine, first mentioned in 1447.
A former silrada of Rohatyn Raion, Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast, Ukraine, established in August 1989, merged into Rohatyn urban hromada in June 2020.
